subject: Demo follow-up: Proposed POC onboarding plan for HorizonBridge
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Cole <avery.cole@horizonbridge.com>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@horizonbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo follow-up: Proposed POC onboarding plan for HorizonBridge

Hi Avery / Jordan —

Thanks again for your time today — appreciated the clear context on the search and summarization flows you want to validate. Quick recap from our side and a proposed POC onboarding plan so we can align on scope, success criteria, and owners.

Demo highlights (very short):
- Retriever + LLM fusion for document search and long-context summarization
- End-to-end latency baseline measured in demo environment (~420ms for 512 tokens with default batching)
- Observability hooks: per-route latency/cost and token breakdown in Redwood Console

Proposed POC objectives (3 weeks):
1) Functional: validate retrieval->answer quality on three canonical prompt sets (Support KB, Product Docs, Legal)
2) Performance: baseline throughput target 40–60 req/s; median p99 latency target <= 350ms for the core API path
3) Cost: demonstrate 20–30% unit-cost improvement vs current infra using batching + prefix cache

Suggested onboarding timeline & milestones:
- Week 0 (prep): share dataset examples, service account for test ingestion, and sign a quick Start SOW (we can draft)
- Week 1: ingest sample data + baseline runs (we'll provide ingestion scripts and a small staging instance)
- Week 2: quality tuning + 2 optimization passes (quantization/adjusted batching)
- Week 3: acceptance run and handoff to your engs for production checklist

Owners (initial):
- Redwood: Soojin (technical lead), Marissa (AE, commercial lead), Ben (solutions)
- HorizonBridge: Avery (product), Jordan (infra) — please correct if I have roles swapped.

Next steps — please reply with: 1) confirmation of the success criteria above (or suggested edits); 2) approval to schedule a 30-min kickoff (propose Tue Jul 6 or Wed Jul 7); 3) list of any compliance docs you need up front (SOC2, encryption, data residency).

I've attached a short POC_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx and the demo recording for your reference.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Attachments: POC_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx, demo-recording-20270626.mp4
From: Avery Cole <avery.cole@horizonbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@horizonbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: Proposed POC onboarding plan for HorizonBridge

Thanks Soojin — good write-up. A few clarifications from our side so the POC delivers useful signals: 

1) Success criteria — can we tighten the perf numbers? Our bar for production would be p95 < 300ms and sustain 50 req/s for 90% of the test window. If that’s unrealistic for the first pass, tell us which levers you expect will be used and a realistic target timeline.

2) Data residency — we need to confirm that test data stays in our US region and that any logs with customer content are only accessible by our teams (or will the hosted demo instance redact/obfuscate?).

3) SOC2 evidence — our InfoSec will want a short PDF with SOC2 scope + contact to kick internal review. Can you send that?

We can do Tue Jul 6 for kickoff at 10am PT.

-Avery

Avery — great questions. Quick answers and how we'd address each item during the POC: 

- Perf targets: p95 < 300ms is aggressive but achievable with a small config change + dedicated staging capacity. Week 1 baseline run will give us the true delta; if needed we'll enable a low-latency kernel path and tighter batching parameters in Week 2. I’ll log the target as p95 <= 320ms for acceptance with a stretch goal of 300ms.

- Data residency & logs: for the POC we’ll provision a US-only staging cluster in our US region and restrict console access to the people on the owners list. Logs that contain customer content are stored in your project namespace and we’ll ship them to your S3 if you prefer. We will not share customer content outside your tenancy.

- SOC2: attached a short SOC2_Summary.pdf (scope & compliance contact) — that'll feed your InfoSec.

Operational kickoff proposed: Tue Jul 6, 10:00–10:30 PT. Agenda: intro + ingestion plan + data access + immediate blockers.

Deliverables we'll bring to kickoff:
- Ingestion script + sample schema
- Staging cluster access guide
- Acceptance checklist (populated with targets)

If that all looks good I’ll send a calendar invite and a minimal Start SOW for signature.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
